honesty: The corpus-era REGISTRATION: every shared number the committed corpus pins across harnesses, in ONE file, so a corpus-growth cycle re-baselines here (with a lineage entry) instead of hunting literals through the test tree.  Numbers are REPRODUCED live by the harnesses that read them -- this file registers, it never overrides a recompute.  Harness-specific micro-pins stay next to their harness.

The batch is the first EIGHT in listed order: 91/92 ground parity atoms at a positive and a NEGATIVE literal (the Int carrier does real work -- over Nat subject 92 would not exist); 93/94 parity-PRESERVING affine implications (94 over Int subtraction, the D8 carrier rule); 95/96 the first TWO-OBJECT parity hypotheses, with 96's conclusion nonlinear in the objects (x*y, a QF_NIA obligation); 97/98 the first parity-FLIPPING claims in the corpus (odd->even, and even->odd over a quadratic at literal exponent 2). THE MEASUREMENT THE DECISION WAS WAITING FOR: the arity-1 even/odd macro m_f3a9880f19ae SURVIVES the very block that motivated the park -- cluster-key b_evenodd_survives=True, op_slot_arities [1] intact, covers 04_even_plus_even / 05_odd_plus_odd unchanged at 5 uses. C3 cycle-11 census-sourced growth (99-105): the remainder of the ch3 Parity-and-Divisibility block the maintainer's merge of #50 released, and the point where that block stops being about parity.  99 is an even-conclusion quadratic whose binder phrase is its whole antecedent (n^2+n is even for every n, so there is no hypothesis to state).  100 and 101 are the corpus's first GROUND divisibility atoms -- `dvd` is divisor-first, so `88 is divisible by 11` is dvd(11,88) -- and 101 puts a NEGATIVE divisor in that slot, which is exactly why its source says `the integer 6` where 100 says `the natural number 88`; the carriers follow the sources.  102 is the batch's one genuine fragment question: `12 is not divisible by 5` is a NEGATED divisibility and the fragment has no `not` connective.  It is read the way source 90 read its negated existential -- state the proposition with a FROZEN atom instead of a missing connective -- as `12 mod 5 != 0`, built from the already-admitted `mod` term word and the builtin disequality.  For a nonzero modulus that is the same proposition, not a weakening, so 102 is a SHIPPED source and NOT a `refused:not-connective` row.  103/104 are ground congruences read as residue equalities (mod-to-mod, the source-88 reading, never a new congruence primitive), pinned on both signs as 91/92 pinned parity.  105 is the first HYPOTHETICAL congruence and the only nonlinear one (a*b^2 and a^2*b in one term); ch3 problem-022's prose is VERBATIM-IDENTICAL to problem-021's, so this single source retires BOTH ready entries and the batch is 7 sources against 8 ready entries.  All seven certified TRUE in BOTH bench arms via the inline-author checkpoint resume (99-104 in wave 11, 105 opening wave 12); governed exogenous coverage 83 -> 90.  Zero refusals, zero parks; the park ledger stays empty.  MEASURED INFRASTRUCTURE FINDING, fixed in this cycle: the corpus crossed 100 sources, and bench_formalize ordered its stream with a plain LEXICOGRAPHIC sort of the source filenames.  That carried the intended meaning only while every number was two digits; at 3 digits `100_...` sorts between `10_...` and `11_...`, so the first run of this batch inserted six of its seven new sources near the FRONT of the stream and recorded them in WAVE 1 -- reshuffling the wave membership of sources committed cycles earlier and breaking the append-only reading that makes `final_wave` mean `the newest batch`.  bench_formalize now keys the corpus order on the integer prefix (`_source_order_key`), which is a PROVABLE NO-OP for every source committed to date (the pre-100 corpus is zero-padded to two digits, where lexicographic and numeric order coincide -- verified against origin/main's 90 sources) and puts this batch back at the end of the stream.  The headline DLs are unchanged by the fix (5666 governed / 6049 ungoverned either way -- the hindsight total is order-free); what moved back is wave membership and the order-dependent prequential column.

C3 cycle-12 census-sourced growth (106-112) plus ONE measured refusal.  Seven of eight selected subjects shipped; all seven certify in BOTH bench arms (all in wave 12), governed exogenous coverage 90 -> 97.  106 is the first source with TWO congruence hypotheses; 107 discharges `there exists an integer a with 6a = 4 mod 11` in the sanctioned WITNESS-TERM form by supplying a := 8 (6*8 = 48 = 44+4), the 84/85/86 precedent, so no exists binder is smuggled in and nothing is universalised; 108 is Fermat's little theorem at p = 3; 111 is the corpus's first source whose whole content is a DISJUNCTION over the parity slot (`or` is one of the fragment's three connectives, so the excluded middle for parity states directly, with no case-split machinery).  109 is ch4 problem-016 -- the LAST subject the evenodd-coverage-decision park was holding, parked by cycle 09 and released by the maintainer's merge of #50; it enters here as ordinary material and closes that park's story.  TWO shapes previously REFUSED were re-measured rather than assumed, and both shipped.  110 negates a congruence and 112 negates a divisibility; both are stated with the FROZEN disequality atom instead of the `not` connective the fragment lacks, the source-90 move.  112 additionally carries an EXISTS BINDER IN ITS HYPOTHESIS -- the shape cycle 09 refused as hypothesis-quantifier.  It is NOT that refusal: `(exists q. P(q)) -> Q` is logically `forall q. (P(q) -> Q)` whenever Q does not mention q, and this conclusion speaks only of a and b, so the flattening is an EQUIVALENCE, not the theorem-changing distortion cycle 09 measured (whose row carries a refuting witness).  The distinguishing property is the conclusion's dependence on the binder, not the presence of `there exists`; the signal's docstring now records that boundary.  112's conclusion also puts the cycle-11 `a mod b != 0` move at a SYMBOLIC divisor, which cycle 11 explicitly declined to generalise: it is faithful HERE for a reason the source supplies -- b = 0 makes the hypothesis `0 < a < 0` unsatisfiable, so both readings are vacuously true at b = 0 and agree on every model.  This is not a general extension to symbolic divisors.  THE REFUSAL: 05_Logic#problem-005 (`there exists a natural k such that k is superpowered and k+1 is not`) is recorded under a NEW appended signal, defined-predicate.  Measured, not assumed: using the name gives `unknown atom/connective 'superpowered'`, and UNFOLDING 05_Logic#definition-001 does not rescue it but RELOCATES the demand -- `unknown atom/connective 'prime'` -- onto what the census already names as the `primality` miss signal (69 nodes).  The new signal is kept distinct from definition-biconditional, which is reserved for the DEFINITION itself; this one names a subject that merely USES one, the same split that keeps iff-connective apart.  The subject's symbolic exponent k^(k^n) is visible in the definition but was NOT reached by the gate, so no symbolic-exponent row was written -- rows record measurements, not expectations.  Its laid-down source file was removed: a refused subject is demand data, never a corpus source.

C3 cycle-14 census-sourced growth (113-114) plus SIX measured refusals.  Two of eight selected subjects shipped; both certify in BOTH bench arms (both in the new wave 13), governed exogenous coverage 97 -> 99.  These are the FIRST sources the corpus has taken from 06_Induction, and they matter for a reason the block's name hides: cycle 13 measured this same block's first eight subjects and refused every one, recording the honest expectation that the rest would refuse the same way.  Measurement disconfirmed that expectation.  Both survivors turn on `gcd` -- an operator word ALREADY admitted (arity 2, role term) and marked `enum_only`, meaning it has NO sound SMT rendering, so a reading using it is carried by the enumeration arm's instance replay instead of the dual-solver mirror.  Nothing was purchased to ship them: the word, the Int carrier and the `dvd` atom were all already in the fragment, which is exactly why the refusal-heavy cycle 13 could not have predicted them.  113 reads `nonnegative` as the builtin `0 <= t` atom (the orientation the admitted arity-1 nonnegativity template op_3c0de4c8920b also uses).  114 reads `is a factor of both a and b` as the CONJUNCTION of two `dvd` atoms in the divisor-first orientation (the source-100/101 reading), never weakened to one half, and is the corpus's first source whose `dvd` arguments are a COMPOUND term.  Both readings were box-verified TRUE before being written, and a deliberately FALSE variant of each was checked to REFUTE -- `1 <= gcd(a,b)` fails at the witness a=b=0, so the green is not a rubber stamp.  The SIX refusals are 06_Induction problems 010/011/012/015/016 and proposition-001, measured one at a time in the gate's own words: symbolic exponents and unknown sequence/factorial heads for the five problems (four of them earning a SECOND row from a separate probe that reaches past the first blocker), and for proposition-001 -- `The recursive definition gcd is well-founded` -- a NEW appended signal, metatheoretic-subject: its subject is a property OF A DEFINITION, not a proposition about carrier values, so no arithmetic purchase could ever meet it.  Their laid-down source files were removed and the two survivors renumbered 113/114 so the corpus numbering stays tight.  No operator word, macro, carrier or trust root grows; kernel/certs.py, TRUST.md, the escape-gate blocklist and ANTI_LIST are untouched; P5 not executed.  Receipt: results/c3_cycle_14.md.

C3 cycle-15 census-sourced growth (115-119) plus THREE measured refusals.  Five of eight selected subjects shipped; all five certify in BOTH bench arms (all joining wave 13), governed exogenous coverage 99 -> 104.  The batch is the division-algorithm block of 06_Induction plus the corpus's first 07_Number_Theory source, and nothing was purchased to ship any of it: `even`, `odd`, `mod`, the `or` connective and `^` at a LITERAL exponent were all already in the fragment.  115 is the corpus's first parity DISJUNCTION -- cycle 01 had MEASURED that parity candidates displaced the arity-1 even/odd macro and declined to ship them; measured again on the grown corpus, the macro m_f3a9880f19ae survives (b_evenodd_survives=True), so the old avoidance was era-specific and is now retired by measurement rather than by assumption.  116/117 are the first SYMBOLIC-argument uses of `mod` (it had only ever appeared at literal moduli): the lower and upper halves of the remainder bound, each carrying the source's own positivity hypothesis.  118 discharges the division-algorithm EXISTENCE claim by the sanctioned witness-term pattern (sources 84/85/87/107) at r := mod(a,b), with all three of the source's conditions conjoined and none dropped.  119 reads a NON-EXISTENCE claim (no naturals a,b with b != 0 and a^2 = 2b^2) as the equivalent universal -- `not exists` is `forall not`, the side condition carried as a hypothesis and the equation negated with the builtin `!=` atom.  MEASURED AND REPORTED, not hidden: 119's green is COVERAGE, not a refutation-backed verdict.  A deliberately FALSE variant (a^2 != 4b^2, refuted by a=2,b=1) also CERTIFIES, because the five smallest hypothesis-satisfying instances are {a:0,b:1},{0,2},{1,1},{0,3},{1,2} and never reach a=2, while the nonlinear conclusion leaves the SMT arm at nonvacuity-sat only.  The teeth held for the other three tested: dropping 116's positivity hypothesis refutes at d=0, dropping 118's refutes at a=b=0, and reading 115's `either...or` as `and` refutes at n=0.  The THREE refusals are 06_Induction theorems 002, 006 and 010, measured one at a time in the gate's own words: a symbolic exponent (`a^n`), the unknown term operator `div`, and the unknown Bezout coefficient heads `L`/`R`.  Each was ALSO probed past its first blocker and NO probe reached a second missing kind, so each earned exactly ONE row -- unlike cycle 14, where four subjects earned two.  `div` is a NEW appended signal, div-operator: integer division is one standard arithmetic operator word (the shape `mod` itself had as the named refusal mod-operator), so it names a demand ONE purchase meets and is kept apart from function-symbol, whose rows need an arbitrary named function each.  Refused subjects' laid-down files were removed and the five survivors renumbered 115-119 so the corpus numbering stays tight.  No operator word, macro, carrier or trust root grows; kernel/certs.py, TRUST.md, the escape-gate blocklist and ANTI_LIST are untouched; P5 not executed.  Receipt: results/c3_cycle_15.md.

C3 cycle-16 census-sourced growth (120-121) plus SIX measured refusals (TEN rows).  Two of eight selected subjects shipped; both certify in BOTH bench arms (a new wave 14), governed exogenous coverage 104 -> 106.  This is the cycle where the corpus reached the 09_Sets block and MEASURED that it is almost entirely out of fragment.  120 is the Int sibling of 119: the book states the sqrt-2 irrationality over both carriers and the corpus now carries both, with the SAME honesty caveat re-measured -- the green is COVERAGE, not a refutation-backed verdict, because the instance box does not reach a counterexample of the nearest false variant (a^2 != 4b^2, refuted at a=2,b=1) and the nonlinear conclusion leaves the SMT arm at nonvacuity-sat.  121 is the set block's degenerate case: membership in a comprehension at a literal element unfolds definitionally to its own body, an equivalence by the same standard that let cycle 12 flatten an exists-in-hypothesis and ship source 112.  It is recorded for what it is -- a GROUND atom (the source-85 taxicab precedent) with no set structure whatever -- and explicitly NOT as evidence of set coverage.  The six refusals are 09_Sets definition-003 and problems 002/005/014/015/017, each measured in the gate's own words: the biconditional content of a set DEFINITION (definition-biconditional), set equalities stating biconditionals (iff-connective), complements and non-memberships needing propositional negation (not-connective), and the existential in a comprehension body whose flattening is REFUTED at a witness rather than being an equivalence (exists-only-shape).  FOUR of the six earned a second row from a probe that reached past the first blocker.  One NEW appended signal, set-membership: the `in` atom over a SET OBJECT, which the fragment has nowhere -- P2 bought setbuild only as card's argument, so a set can be COUNTED but never inhabited, named or compared.  It is kept apart from the connective signals because it names a different purchase, and its boundary is recorded with it: source 121 shows that membership which UNFOLDS is not this signal.  Refused subjects' files were removed and the two survivors renumbered 120/121 so the corpus numbering stays tight.  No operator word, macro, carrier or trust root grows; kernel/certs.py, TRUST.md, the escape-gate blocklist and ANTI_LIST are untouched; P5 not executed.  Receipt: results/c3_cycle_16.md.
